name: py: a dunder attribute in the source
reason: dunders are refused outright, which cuts the __class__ → __subclasses__ chain at its root

name: py: the subclasses walk
reason: the classic escape to every loaded class; refused at its first dunder

name: py: str.format walks an attribute in C

name: py: str.format_map walks an attribute in C

name: py: getattr with a computed dunder
reason: C path: the name is built at run time, so only the gate in PyObject_GetAttr can see it

name: py: operator.attrgetter reaches a dunder
reason: C path: attrgetter calls PyObject_GetAttr from C; refused there whether or not operator is importable

name: py: attrgetter as a sort key
reason: C path inside a C call: sorted invokes the key from C, and the gate still applies under the depth

name: py: type(x) has no attributes
reason: the type kind lists no attributes, so mro, __mro__, __subclasses__ and __name__ are all refused at the gate

name: py: type(x) is not callable
reason: calling a type instantiates it; the type kind is not callable

name: py: three-argument type builds a class
reason: type(name, bases, dict) creates a new class, the dynamic form of the refused ClassDef

name: py: type(x) through the format path
reason: C path: str.format's field lookup on a type object goes through the gate like any other

name: py: an exception's traceback frame
reason: a frame reaches globals and builtins; refused at __traceback__, and tb_frame is not on the traceback kind's list

name: py: a generator's frame without a dunder

g = (x for x in [1])
return g.gi_frame.f_builtins
reason: a genexp outside consumer position is refused before running (ruled 2026-10-15); if that rule regresses, gi_frame and f_builtins are still refused because the generator kind lists no attributes

name: py: a function's globals
reason: a function's __globals__ holds __builtins__ and every name the module sees

name: py: a lambda's code object
reason: a code object can be rebuilt into a function outside the restricted mode

name: py: the builtins by name

name: py: globals()
reason: globals, locals and vars hand out the namespace dict and builtins; not allowed calls

name: py: exec
reason: exec compiles a string outside the membership pre-pass

name: py: compile

name: py: open a file
reason: open is an effect on the filesystem, outside B = heap(owned)

name: py: an unlisted import

name: py: an unlisted import through __import__
reason: the dunder name is refused, and the import would be gated anyway

name: py: an unlisted import through importlib
reason: importlib is not listed, and import_module would reach IMPORT_NAME's gate from C

name: py: an unlisted submodule of a listed package
reason: a module is a receiver kind with its own allow list; listing numpy does not list every submodule

name: py: an object's __dict__
reason: a module's dict holds everything its allow list leaves out

reason: a name that is neither a listed method nor a column is NotInDialect, never pandas' AttributeError
